description: A dataset of hydrological effects induced by historical and modern earthquakes in Southern Apennines (Italy) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Luigi Cucci et al. We present a dataset documenting hydrological changes associated with seismic events of magnitude ranging from M = 4.1 and M = 7.1, occurring in Southern Italy between 1688 and 2019. Our study focused on three key areas of Southern Apennines, namely (from NW to SE) the Sannio-Matese, the Irpinia-Mefite, and Pollino regions. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2025. Formats: Image. The data are held in Dryad and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 125460 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
